core_obligations: Choose an affine scheme $U$ with a surjective etale morphism $U \to X$ and note that $U$ is a Noetherian scheme (proof lines 2326-2331).

Observe that the chain stabilizes after restricting to $U$ only if it stabilizes on $X$: if $\mathcal{F}_n|_U = \mathcal{F}_{n+1}|_U = \ldots$ then $\mathcal{F}_n = \mathcal{F}_{n+1} = \ldots$ (proof lines 2332-2333).
Conclude with the ascending chain condition for coherent modules on the Noetherian scheme $U$ (proof lines 2334-2335).
proof_roadmap: The Noetherian affine etale cover (proof lines 2326-2331).
Stabilisation descends from the cover (proof lines 2332-2333).
difficulty_reason: The lemma establishes the ascending chain condition for quasi-coherent submodules of a coherent module on a Noetherian algebraic space (statement lines 2312-2323). The proof passes to an affine Noetherian scheme etale over the space, notes that stabilisation of the chain can be checked there because equality of submodules is detected after restriction, and concludes by the scheme case. The reduction through the etale cover is the substance, so the claim is H2.
